title: MediKiosk — AI-Powered Pre-Consultation Assistant
description: An AI-powered healthcare pre-consultation system that collects, organizes, and summarizes patient information before doctor consultation with voice-assisted workflow.
highlights: Voice-assisted workflow covering symptoms, medical history, medications, and lifestyle
Integrated AYUSH Dashavidha Pariksha, medical documents analysis, and red flag detection
Built with React + Django + FastAPI microservices and ABDM/FHIR health data standards
Participated in Smart India Hackathon 2026 with this solution

title: ShopEase — E-Commerce Platform
description: A responsive e-commerce platform with customer and seller modules, authentication, product browsing, wishlist, cart, and order management powered by Angular.
highlights: Dual customer & seller module architecture with role-based authentication
Built reusable Angular components and services for scalable UI architecture
Cart, wishlist, product browsing, and order management with JSON Server data layer
Fully responsive UI with Bootstrap + custom CSS design system

title: Multimodal Music Mood Classifier
description: A machine learning system to classify music by emotional mood using multimodal features, including preprocessing, feature extraction, model training, and evaluation.
highlights: Multimodal feature extraction combining audio spectrogram and metadata inputs
Implemented preprocessing pipeline with feature normalization and augmentation
Trained and evaluated multiple ML classification models for mood category detection

title: Job Vacancy Aggregator
description: A platform that aggregates job listings from multiple portals into a unified, user-friendly interface with data processing and storage capabilities.
highlights: Aggregates listings from multiple job portals into a single unified dashboard
Data processing pipeline with Pandas for normalization and deduplication
Flask REST backend with SQLite/MySQL storage and effective search/filter features

title: Smart Inventory Management System
description: An inventory management application using object-oriented programming for product tracking, stock management, and record maintenance.
highlights: OOP-driven architecture with clean separation of product, stock, and record layers
Real-time stock tracking with low-stock alerts and reporting module
Developed as an academic deep-dive into design patterns and Java OOP principles

title: Finance Tracker
description: A personal finance management application to track income, expenses, and account balances with dynamic transaction management and real-time balance calculations.
highlights: Dynamic transaction management with real-time balance calculations
Visual breakdown of income vs. expenses with category grouping
Persistent local storage for offline-first personal finance tracking
